# `bitmap_and_agg`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
bitmap_and_agg(child)
```

Returns a bitmap that is the bitwise AND of all of the bitmaps from the child
expression. The input should be bitmaps created from bitmap_construct_agg().

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- bitmap_and_agg, example 1
> SELECT substring(hex(bitmap_and_agg(col)), 0, 6) FROM VALUES (X 'F0'), (X '70'), (X '30') AS tab(col);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

```sql
-- bitmap_and_agg, example 2
> SELECT substring(hex(bitmap_and_agg(col)), 0, 6) FROM VALUES (X 'FF'), (X 'FF'), (X 'FF') AS tab(col);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```
